member.name: BookmarkMargin.Class
member.summary: Renders an icon beside every visible marked line and toggles a bookmark when a left-button press lands on that line's margin row.
member.remarks: The press requests the toggle through , and the horizontal press position is not inspected. The margin invalidates itself after a toggle. The margin installs an amber-flag sample icon so it is visible without configuration; a host replaces it through , , or a override.

member.name: SampleIconBrush
member.summary: The amber brush the margin installs as its default icon brush.

member.name: SampleIconGeometry
member.summary: The bookmark-flag geometry the margin installs as its default icon geometry.

member.name: BookmarkMargin
member.summary: Initializes a new instance of the class.
member.param: The source that queries and toggles bookmarks.

member.name: OnBookmarkToggleRequested
member.summary: Requests a bookmark toggle for the document line at the supplied offset and reports whether the request was handled.
member.param: The zero-based offset of the start of the clicked line.
member.returns: when the toggle was performed; otherwise, .
member.remarks: The default toggles through and returns , so the margin invalidates itself and marks the click handled. A derived margin overrides this member for a different gesture policy (modifier keys, confirmation, or a context menu); returning leaves the click unhandled and does not invalidate the margin. The member runs only for a click that resolved to a visual line.
